'''Redlio''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a [[Hunting/Legends|huntress]] for [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SSR" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'' dates itself between the end of {{Film|IV}} and before the end of [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the works immediately following the former to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and the latter to [[3 ABY/Legends|3]]-[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Secrets of the Sisar Run'' is set between 0 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]] and 4 ABY.</ref> the woman worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Sandwind Team (Sriluur)|Sandwind Team]], an infamous six-person team of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that conducted their work on<ref name="SSR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur's]] [[Lesser Cueva Expanse]]. The success of several Rebel missions was owed to the intelligence resources of the team.<ref name="SSR" />
